reviews.text: really like this cream. It feels rich and moisturizing but absorbs nicely without leaving my skin feeling heavy. My eye area feels smoother, softer and well hydrated after using it. It is also gentle on my skin and I haven’t experienced any irritation. I’m very happy with it
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款乳霜。質地豐富、保濕，但吸收得好好，唔會令皮膚覺得厚重。用完之後，眼周感覺更加滑、更軟，保濕充足。呢款亦都對皮膚溫和，我冇試過任何刺激。我好滿意。

reviews.text: After using only for a short time, It’s doing a great job! This cream has a really soothing feeling and makes my under eyes feel more full. I will keep using in the hopes of visual results which I’m sure will come with time. But for initial use, it’s doing great!
reviews.zh: 雖然用咗冇幾耐，但效果好好！呢款乳霜用落好舒緩，令我眼下位置感覺更加飽滿。我會繼續用，希望會見到視覺上嘅改善，我相信會隨住時間慢慢出現。不過初步用落，表現好好！

reviews.text: Bioheal BOH 3D Lifting Eye Cream features probiotic complex and multi-peptides to boost elasticity, smooth fine dry lines and relieve eye puffiness. It has a lightweight non-comedogenic texture, free of retinol and harsh irritants, suitable for sensitive skin and people aged 25+ for early anti-aging maintenance. It offers decent firming and plumping effects gradually, yet it cannot eliminate deep wrinkles or stubborn dark circles, and its moisturizing power is insufficient for extremely dry skin.
reviews.zh: Bioheal BOH 3D Lifting Eye Cream 採用益生菌複合物同多肽，幫助提升彈性、令細乾紋變平滑，並舒緩眼部浮腫。質地清爽、不易致粉刺（non-comedogenic），不含視黃醇同刺激性較強嘅成分，適合敏感肌同25歲以上、需要早期抗老保養嘅人士。效果會逐步帶來一定程度嘅緊緻同飽滿，但唔能夠消除深層皺紋或者頑固嘅黑眼圈，而且對於極度乾燥嘅皮膚，保濕力唔夠。

reviews.text: This eye cream is the best I've tried. I'm absolutely delighted. The cream is slightly thick. In the morning, I apply a very thin layer, and it's completely absorbed. But in the evening, I apply the cream as thickly as possible for a greater effect. During the first 10 days, I noticed noticeable swelling under my eyes in the morning from the cream, but my skin adapted and stopped swelling after a while. The skin under my eyes really did become noticeably denser and more hydrated than before; the effect is similar to polynucleotide injections into the eye area. I'm planning to order more products in this series.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜係我試過最好嘅一款，我非常滿意。乳霜質地稍為厚身。早上我會塗一層好薄嘅，好快就完全吸收；但係晚上，我就會盡量塗厚啲，希望效果更加好。頭10日，我早上會見到眼底明顯浮腫，但皮膚慢慢適應咗，之後就唔再浮腫。眼下嘅皮膚真係比以前明顯咁更加緊實、更加水潤；效果類似眼周打多核苷酸針（polynucleotide injection）嘅效果。我打算再訂呢個系列嘅其他產品。

reviews.text:
I am 49 years old and I need a really good cream and after hearing so many good thinks about it I decided to give it a try and I was not disappointed. Because of my age and the wrinkles I have tried A LOT of creams and this one is the best so far.
It melts into my skin and it is so hydrating that it smoothes out wrinkles leaving my skin plump and really moisturized all day. The packaging is very nice and looks luxurious too. It works perfect under sunscreen and concealer too. I highly recommend it for everyone.
reviews.zh:
我49歲，好需要一款好嘅乳霜，聽咗好多人讚，所以決定試吓，而且冇令我失望。因為我嘅年紀同皺紋，我試過好多乳霜，呢款係目前最好嘅。
佢會溶入皮膚，保濕力好強，令皺紋變得平滑，皮膚飽滿，成日都好水潤。包裝好靚，都好似好奢華。佢搽喺防曬同遮瑕膏底下都好啱。我非常推薦畀所有人。

reviews.text:
I used several tubes of this eye cream it used to be thick and I loved it and the tubes were 30 ml 

Now after reformulation the size reduced to 25 ml the eye cream it self less thick and very scented it was this fragrant 
I think i won't repurchase this eye cream anymore
reviews.zh:
我用過好多管呢款眼霜，以前佢質地厚身，我好鍾意，而且每管都係30ml。

而家改咗配方之後，容量縮細到25ml，眼霜本身都冇咁厚，而且香味好濃，好香。

我諗我唔會再回購呢款眼霜。

reviews.text: This eye cream is a little on the thicker side, it applies nicely and absorbs well. As with this line of products, it does have a scent, which does disappear after a few minutes. I don't notice a big difference with the wrinkles, but it did not cause any of the little bumps (milia) under my eyes
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜質地稍為厚身，搽落好服帖，吸收都好。同呢個系列嘅產品一樣，佢都有香味，但係幾分鐘之後就會消失。我未見到皺紋有明顯改善，不過佢冇令我眼下出現任何脂肪粒（milia）。

reviews.text: First time I used this it was given as a gift. I sleep on my face so I had some premature wrinkles under my eyes so I figured it was worth a shot. With consistent use my under eyes have dramatically improved. This was my second repurchase and I’m so happy with this product definitely recommend
reviews.zh: 第一次用呢款係人哋送嘅禮物。我成日面埋枕頭瞓，所以眼下有啲提早出現嘅細紋，我覺得值得一試。持續使用之後，我嘅眼下有顯著改善。呢個係我第二次回購，我好滿意呢款產品，一定推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
